purpose: Teach: 顎/灸/セラピー/ブタ/歌劇/抱きしめ/アクセル/卓球

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の顎、上向きでお洒落でいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer had such an elegant way of holding herself today.
lines.style: Warm, genuine observation. Soft emphasis on 'elegant.' Breathy and intimate—the kind of thing you notice and want to share. No performance, just noticing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様が灸の話で盛り上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, did you see how animated they got talking about moxibustion? It was lovely.
lines.style: Bright, engaged tone. Light energy without pushing. Speaking to something small that delighted her. Natural cadence of someone sharing a good moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、リラクゼーションセラピーのメニューも検討しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we should think about adding a relaxation therapy option to the menu.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not directive. Thoughtful pace. 'We' instead of 'you'—collaborative, inviting. Leaning into the possibility together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ブタの貯金箱、お土産売り場に並べたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I put those pig piggy banks out on the souvenir shelf like we talked about.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but with underlying warmth. Small pride in having done it. Direct, efficient—the tone of someone checking in on a shared plan.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、歌劇を見に行かれるそうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned they're going to see an opera soon.
lines.style: Quiet thoughtfulness. Slight wonder in the voice—the kind of detail that stays with you. Slower pace, like turning it over in her mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りで子どもを抱きしめたお父さん、いらしたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, remember that dad at the festival holding his little one? He came in today.
lines.style: Tender, almost gentle. Soft recognition—the voice of someone noticing kindness and wanting to mark it. Slight smile implied. No rush.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の車のアクセル音がすごかったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer's car had quite the engine on it, didn't it?
lines.style: Dry, slightly amused. Understated irony—not mocking, just observing something absurd with gentle wit. Raised eyebrow in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、卓球の大会、お客様優勝されたそうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, apparently that customer won their table tennis tournament.
lines.style: Delighted and energetic. Brightness on the news itself. Quick rhythm, genuine happiness for them. The warmth of someone rooting for the people in her orbit.
